decisions.reason: The particle therapy market is still developing, so the option value from this early, specialized product justifies keeping it while uncertainty persists.
Small-field dosimetry demand is growing and its prospects remain unresolved, so the option is worth more than its low carrying cost.
As a second small chamber, it may compete for resources, but no negative results have resolved the option yet, so keep under real options logic.
A standard chamber has many substitutes and lower option value, but its carrying costs are modest and results have not yet closed the option, so keep for now.
Relative dosimetry remains a stable need with unresolved upside, and the cost of keeping it is small relative to the option.
Thimble chambers are a traditional segment with uncertain differentiation, but the option has not resolved and keeping costs little, so retain.
